name: Dice of Fate
source:
Dice of Fate is a short, fantasy visual novel about an adventurer named Teagan who finds a mysterious, enchanted gem! Is it a blessing or a curse? 

[From [url=https://jellicube.itch.io/diceoffate]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《命运骰子》是一部短篇奇幻视觉小说，讲述了一位名叫蒂根的冒险家发现了一颗神秘而迷人的宝石的故事！这是祝福还是诅咒？

[来自[url=https://jellicube.itch.io/diceoffate]Itch.io[/url]]
